name: Broadsides Lantern
holdAbility: Hold to drop a bomb from above that explodes after 1 second. Deals 750 damage and can interrupt Behemoths.
instantAbility: Tap to fire a cannonball from above that deals 350 damage or, against airborne Behemoths, deals 450 damage and critically strikes.

name: Drask's Eye
holdAbility: Fires a lightning bolt in a direction that deals 150 Shock damage multiple times as it passes through enemies.

name: Embermane's Rapture
holdAbility: Create a fire ball in front of you that explodes after 5 seconds, dealing 850 Blaze damage to all nearby Behemoths.

name: Koshai's Bloom
holdAbility: Dash in a direction, deal 750 Terra damage to nearby enemies upon arrival.
instantAbility: 10% of damage dealt will heal you for 8 seconds.

name: Pangar's Shine
holdAbility: Create a frost pillar in front of you that deals 960 Frost damage to nearby enemies over 12 seconds.

name: Recruit's Lantern
holdAbility: Disperses aether that allows the Slayer to track the Behemoth.
instantAbility: Grants a 50 hit point shield (doesn't stack)

name: Shrike's Zeal
holdAbility: Creates an aura that grants nearby slayers 15% increased move speed and attack speed for 15 seconds.

name: Skarn's Defiance
holdAbility: Surrounds the slayer in swirling stone that deals 900 Terra damage to nearby enemies over 10 seconds.
instantAbility: Grants a 250 hit point shield for 12 seconds.
